map.由左右轮行进距离估计位姿变化。: Estimate the pose change from the distance travelled by each wheel.
map.航向变化=两轮行距差/轮距。: The heading change equals the difference in wheel distances divided by the wheelbase.
map.左右轮位移推位姿变化。: Infer the pose change from the left and right wheel displacements.
map.差速底盘航位推算。: Dead reckoning for a differential chassis.
map.ds=(1.0+1.2)/2=1.1m，dθ=(1.2−1.0)/0.4=0.5: ds = (1.0 + 1.2)/2 = 1.1 m and dθ = (1.2 - 1.0)/0.4 = 0.5 rad; the robot moves forward 1.1 m while turning right by 0.5 rad.
map.dθ=0，纯平移 ds=dl=dr。: dθ = 0 and the motion is pure translation with ds = dl = dr.
map.两轮间距；dθ=(dr−dl)/L。: The distance between the two wheels, with dθ = (dr - dl)/L.
map.轮径误差、打滑使积分漂移，需融合 IMU/视觉校正。: Wheel radius error and slip make the integral drift, so IMU or visual fusion is needed to correct it.
map.差值越大转角越大；右轮行距大于左轮时 Δθ 为正（逆时针，即左转）。: The larger the difference, the larger the turn; when the right wheel travels farther than the left, Δθ is positive (counter-clockwise, i.e. a left turn).
map.前进 1.1m 并左转 0.5rad（逆时针）。: Moves forward 1.1 m and turns left by 0.5 rad (counter-clockwise).
map.轮式里程计（本页代码口径）：位移 Δs=(右轮行距 dr+左轮行距 dl)÷2（: Wheel odometry (this page's code basis): displacement Δs = (right wheel travel dr + left wheel travel dl) ÷ 2 (m); heading change Δθ = (dr−dl) ÷ wheelbase L (rad), displayed in degrees = Δθ×180÷π (°). Validation: all three fields are required valid numbers via the input guard, otherwise a prompt stops the run. Criteria: no fixed grading; equal wheel travel means straight motion (Δθ = 0), and the larger the difference the sharper the turn; when the right wheel travels farther than the left, Δθ is positive (counterclockwise, i.e. turning left).
map.ds=(1.0+1.2)/2=1.1m，dθ=(1.2−1.0)/0.4=0.5: ds = (1.0+1.2)/2 = 1.1 m, dθ = (1.2−1.0)/0.4 = 0.5 rad; move forward 1.1 m and turn left 0.5 rad (counterclockwise).
